correctness.rationale: Proof independently establishes every Boolean labeling via symplectic basis extension and excludes every dependent or nonorthogonal support; ordered isotropic frame counts yield exact polynomial, and a positive-branch symplectic quotient bounds Littlestone dimension. Three actual independent computational verifiers enumerate binary ranks 1..3 (3/15/135 Lagrangians; exact boundaries), and ternary rank 2 (40 Lagrangians; 80 singleton and 960 pair faces), confirming small cases. No general homology or integral assertions are made.

evidence: The published fixed-rank affine-flat result treats membership in unrestricted affine flats and affinely independent point supports.
The complete-flag result treats nested subspace membership queries and Gaussian multinomial face counts.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A linear/affine-flat classification does not imply extra pairwise isotropy constraints on selected queries, nor online dimension of the symplectic quotient or the new mod-two boundary ranks; the complete-flag setting queries a different object. No broader theorem giving all these consequences was found.

value.rationale: Provides a natural polar-incidence concept class exact all-q all-rank Boolean projection criterion, a sharp adaptive dimension, explicit nonmatroid and nonflag boundaries, and a substantive motivated first rank-three topological invariant with independently reproduced rank 883 and Betti 2897. Distinguishes polar constraints from unrestricted linear/affine-flat and building queries; does not misrepresent standard basis extension as novel.
